entries.subject: Keras
entries.object: weight matrices uniformly by drawing from a range that is computed according to the input and output dimension

spans.text: :begin_tab:`tensorflow` By default, Keras initializes weight matrices uniformly by drawing from a range that is computed according to the input and output dimension, and the bias parameters are all set to zero.

:begin_tab:`jax` By default, Flax initializes weights using `jax.nn.initializers.lecun_normal`, i.e., by drawing samples from a truncated normal distribution centered on 0 with the standard deviation set as the squared root of $1 / \textrm{fan}_{\textrm{in}}$ where `fan_in` is the number of input units in the weight tensor.
